events.text: The world you made has grown old enough to want a law that is not a person. Its priests pray to you less as a face and more as a rule: that the rain is owed, that the seed finds soil. Tonight, looking down at it, you understand that you could stop being its god and become its sky. THE HEAVENLY DAO OF YOUR WORLD.

choices.text: Become the law of your world

effects.log: You let go of the shape you have worn, and go up into the sky of your world, and stay there.

choices.text: Not yet: it still needs a god who listens

effects.log: You stay a god a while longer, and answer one more prayer by hand.

events.text: Far above the clouds of the Upper Realm, your own small world turns in your palm like a pearl. Its priests pray to you less as a face and more as a rule: that the rain is owed, that the seed finds soil. Tonight, looking down at it, you understand that you could stop being its god and become its sky. THE HEAVENLY DAO OF YOUR WORLD.

choices.text: Become the law of your world

effects.log: You set the pearl down in the dark, and go into it, and become its sky.

choices.text: Not yet: it still needs a god who listens

effects.log: You close your hand around it gently and keep it a while longer.

events.text: The elders of the house gather in the ancestral hall, and the eldest asks what everyone has been afraid to ask: what happens to the house when the murim forgets it? Behind the tablets, where nobody else can see, a door you made long ago is waiting, and a whole world on the other side of it. THE GREAT CROSSING.

choices.text: Open the door and lead the whole house through

effects.log: You open the door in the air, and step through first, and they follow.

choices.text: Not yet: the house still belongs here

effects.log: You tell the elders the house will stand. They believe you, for now.

events.text: You are very old now, even for a god, and very tired. Your world is at peace. Its temples hum. Its children leave flowers at the foot of the oldest mountain without knowing why. You could go down there and lie under it, and sleep, and let the whole world dream around you. THE SLEEPING GOD.

choices.text: Go down, and sleep under the mountain

effects.log: You walk into your world one last time, and lie down, and close your eyes.

choices.text: Not yet: there is still something to see

effects.log: You stay awake a little longer. The world does not mind waiting.

events.text: Even above the clouds the years have caught up with you. Your world is at peace. Its temples hum. Its children leave flowers at the foot of the oldest mountain without knowing why. You could go down there and lie under it, and sleep, and let the whole world dream around you. THE SLEEPING GOD.

choices.text: Go down, and sleep under the mountain

effects.log: You leave the Upper Realm without a word, and walk into your world, and lie down.

choices.text: Not yet: there is still something to see

effects.log: You stay awake a little longer. The world does not mind waiting.

events.text: On a cold peak above the sea of clouds every Dao your lives have ever perfected comes back to you at once, from very far away, like old friends arriving on one road. They are not many Daos. They never were. MERGE WITH THE DAO.

choices.text: Walk out onto the one road

effects.log: You stand up, and walk out onto the road, and keep walking.

choices.text: Not yet: sit with them a while

effects.log: You sit with them until dawn, and let them go again, for now.

events.text: Behind the broken Wall Above the Clouds there is no more sky: there is a door, very old, shut from the other side. You could step through it alone. Or you could hold it open, with both hands, for every soul on the road below. OPEN THE HEAVENS.

choices.text: Hold the door open, and step through

effects.log: You put both hands on the door and push, and keep pushing, until light falls all the way down the road.

choices.text: Not yet: turn back to the clouds

effects.log: You leave the door shut a while longer. It has waited this long.

events.text: You walk back to the broken Walls of your lives, one after the other, and stand among the stones. Every life that died here stands with you, and every life that broke through. There is room on the last stone for every name you have ever had. THE ONE WHO WALKED THROUGH.

choices.text: Carve every name, and let the road end here

effects.log: You carve them one under another, slowly, the whole day long.

choices.text: Not yet: the road goes on

effects.log: You put the chisel away. There may be another Wall somewhere.

events.text: There is no one left. The great masters of the age have bowed, fled or fallen, and the halls of the jianghu are empty and afraid. You sit on the highest seat of the murim, alone, and nobody comes up the stair any more. THE LAST MASTER STANDING.

choices.text: Sit in the silence, and let it be the end

effects.log: You stay on the high seat, and the silence closes over you.

choices.text: Not yet: someone will climb the stair again

effects.log: You wait for a challenger. One day, surely, someone will come.

events.text: The debt of all your lives sits in your chest like a stone, and the demon in your heart has never been so strong. Above the clouds, the clean grey of the Upper Realm stretches away in every direction. You could pour all of it out, here, and let the heavens wear it. THE STAINED HEAVENS.

choices.text: Pour it all out into the clouds

effects.log: You open your hands, and the debt and the demon go out of you together.

choices.text: Not yet: hold it in a while longer

effects.log: You close your hands again. The stone in your chest stays.

events.text: The heavens are calling: a road of cloud opens at the edge of the sky, and it is for you. Below it the villages still need a roof mended, an orphan fed, a ford made safe. You could go up. You could also stay, and give every year you have left to the world below. THE ONE WHO STAYED BELOW.

choices.text: Bow to the heavens, and stay

effects.log: You bow to the road of cloud, and turn back down the hill to the village.

choices.text: Not yet: there is still a road to climb

effects.log: You keep the road of cloud in sight, and keep walking toward it.
